description.message: Lets your tafs use the sites you allow in this Chrome profile. Every step is checked by KIFF, and anything risky waits for your approval on your phone.

pair_title.message: Pair this Chrome with your phone

pair_body.message: On your phone, open tafs, then Account › Chrome › Pair. Type the code it shows here.

pair_profile.message: tafs works in its own Chrome profile. Sign in there only to the sites you want your tafs to use.

pair_error_code.message: That code isn't right, or it has expired. Start again on your phone.

pair_error_expired.message: The code expired. Start again on your phone.

pair_error_proof.message: This pairing couldn't be confirmed, so nothing was paired. Start again on your phone.

pair_error_planque.message: tafs couldn't be reached. Try again in a moment.

pair_error_not_released.message: This build of the extension can't pair. Install tafs from the Chrome Web Store.

paired_body.message: Your tafs can use this Chrome only on the sites a grant lists. You approve risky steps on your phone.

idle.message: No taf is working here now.

unpair_confirm.message: Unpair this Chrome? Your tafs won't be able to use it until you pair it again.

paused_failures.message: Paused after three steps in a row didn't work.

step_ask.message: Needs your yes in Chrome for $SITE$

coach_placeholder.message: Ask Coach, or say what a taf should do on this site

coach_error.message: That didn't reach Coach. Try again.

coach_not_started.message: Start Coach on your phone first.

coach_no_session.message: To talk to Coach here, pair this Chrome from your phone.

coach_approve_on_phone.message: Something waits for your approval on your phone.

share_preview.message: This page goes with your message, with password, card and code fields removed:

share_error_site_blocked.message: Pages like this one are never shared: banks, wallets, passwords, payments, health and government.

share_error_bad_url.message: Only https pages can be shared.
